name: Mercury X1
summary: Mercury X1 is Elephant Robotics’ wheeled humanoid robot, combining the Mercury B1 upper body with a mobile base. It has two articulated arms and a screen-based head, with laser, ultrasonic and visual sensing for mobile applications. The platform supports Python and C++ development, ROS tools and robotics simulation software for education, scientific research, service and teleoperation projects. It is listed in the manufacturer’s commercial catalog with dedicated support documentation.
